verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents user-configured recurring schedules for specific built-in workflows: user access reviews use recurring schedules and reminders, and vendor reviews can recur based on risk level. Customizable notifications for regular tasks such as quarterly access reviews add to this. There is no evidence of a general-purpose scheduler for arbitrary jobs or workflows; daily monitoring runs automatically rather than on a user-defined schedule. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary jobs/workflows, API- or MCP-driven schedule management, detailed scheduling docs (cadence options, triggers), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Designate reviewers per system and use recurring schedules, reminders, and status indicators to keep the process moving.
Users can also set up recurring reviews based on risk level
Customize notifications for required regular tasks throughout the year including quarterly user access reviews and annual penetration testing.
